references.text: The account of the woman who was healed by touching Jesus' cloak demonstrates the power of faith and parallels the people's actions in Mark 6:56.
Jesus' prayer in Gethsemane, where he seeks God's will, reflects his care for the people he healed, as described in Mark 6:56.
The story of the woman with bleeding who was healed by touching Jesus' cloak resembles the events in Mark 6:56, where people were healed by touching his cloak.
The people brought the sick into the streets so that Peter's shadow might fall on some of them, showing a similar faith in healing through contact, as seen in Mark 6:56.
Paul's healing miracles in Ephesus, where the sick were healed when cloths or aprons that had touched him were placed on them, show a parallel to the belief in healing through touch in Mark 6:56.
